newsitem.title: USA: AccuMed postpones reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: AccuMed postpones reverse stock split.

text.p: AccuMed International Inc said Friday it had postponed indefinitely a planned one-for-three reverse stock split and will not seek shareholder approval for such a step.

Peter Gombrich, chief executive of AccuMed, said the company instead would ask the shareholders to authorize an increase in outstanding shares. He said he did not know yet how big an increase the board would request.

The company said the decision to postpone the reverse split was made "in light of recent developments," referring to a pact with Leica Microscopy & Systems GmbH of Germany announced earlier today and another, undisclosed pact.
AccuMed is a labororatory diagnostic products company based in Chicago.
